name: Időjárási szakértő
method: Versioned literature guidance plus locally validated statistical analysis; no LLM fine-tuning

sources.title: The influence of meteorological factors on the technical performance of football teams during matches
sources.finding: Weather was associated with selected technical events, including counterattack shots and close-range shots. These are not direct goal or Over 2.5 effects.
limits: Repeated teams and shared match weather
Opponent strength and tactical context insufficiently controlled
Normalized effect units cannot be interpreted as per-degree effects

sources.sample: 3884 complete Spanish first/second division match records, 2013/14–2017/18
sources.finding: Adding weather improved reported match-result classification. This does not establish team-specific goal effects or betting returns.
limits: Described preprocessing order raises leakage concerns
Daily realized weather is not a pre-match forecast
Weather station distance and timing limit accuracy

sources.finding: Wet fast surfaces differ from waterlogging; wind can affect deliveries and defensive errors; heat may alter intensity. These are hypotheses to test, not numeric scoring coefficients.
limits: Illustrative numbers are not fitted coefficients
Do not implement a universal rain-equals-under rule

rules: Separate weather forecast, realized reanalysis and historically available forecast.
Compare the same team and venue role within the same competition, controlling pre-match opponent strength and recency.
Do not equate technical-event associations with goal probabilities or causal effects.
Missing weather, identities, adequate samples or chronological validation imply neutral ranking weight.
Validate on held-out chronological matches, never random-split duplicate team views of the same game.
Only archived pre-match forecast validation can activate forecast-based live weighting; reanalysis alone supports retrospective hypotheses.
Keep market direction explicit: higher total goals supports Over and opposes Under, not both.
Preserve profile-specific styles, data/quote/lockout checks and all DAILY_223 selection rules.
